title: Signature: Coordinator black box
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every coordinator decision is recorded in a tamper-evident black box: plans, approvals, tool calls, validations, and outcomes. Any completed task can be replayed from the black box to verify exactly what happened and why. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers recording every decision tamper-evidently.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 5, 2: 10, 3: 20}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
import hashlib
events = ["plan", "approve"] + ["call-%d" % i for i in range(N)] + ["validate", "done"]
digest = hashlib.sha256("|".join(events).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
print("events:", len(events), "| black-box seal:", digest, "| replayable: True")
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Goal decomposition ledger
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the task goal is decomposed into a tree where each node carries its own success criteria. The ledger tracks which nodes are satisfied, so partial progress is visible and the coordinator knows exactly what remains. Vague goals become checkable trees. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers decomposing goals into criteria-bearing nodes.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: {"total": 4, "done": 3}, 2: {"total": 9, "done": 7}, 3: {"total": 16, "done": 16}}
t, d = CFG[LEVEL]["total"], CFG[LEVEL]["done"]
print("goal nodes: %d/%d satisfied (%.0f%%)" % (d, t, 100.0 * d / t), "| complete:", d == t)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Confidence-gated autonomy
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): the coordinator acts autonomously only when its confidence in the plan exceeds a threshold; below the threshold it asks for guidance. Confidence comes from plan validation scores and historical success on similar tasks, not from self-assurance. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers acting alone only above a confidence threshold.

LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 0.92, 2: 0.68, 3: 0.41}
conf, TH = CFG[LEVEL], 0.75
print("plan confidence %.2f vs threshold %.2f ->" % (conf, TH), "AUTONOMOUS" if conf >= TH else "ask for guidance")

title: Signature: Multi-coordinator handoff
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): long tasks can migrate between coordinators: the full state, plan, ledger, and black box transfer as one sealed package. The receiving coordinator verifies the seal before accepting, so handoffs are lossless and auditable. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers packaging full state for handoff.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 3, 2: 6, 3: 10}
import hashlib, json
state = {"step": CFG[LEVEL], "ledger": list(range(CFG[LEVEL]))}
seal = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
received = dict(state)
ok = hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(received, sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()[:12] == seal
print("handoff seal:", seal, "| verified:", ok)
provenance: Signature original — designed by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH); Signature-generated completion, clearly labeled.

title: Signature: Completion certificate
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): a task is not done when the last step runs; it is done when the coordinator issues a completion certificate: all steps validated, all gates passed, results reconciled. The certificate is the checkable proof of validated completion. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers issuing certificates only after full validation.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: [True, True, True], 2: [True, True, False], 3: [True] * 6}
checks = CFG[LEVEL]
cert = all(checks)
print("checks passed %d/%d" % (sum(checks), len(checks)), "| certificate:", "ISSUED" if cert else "WITHHELD")
